ingredients.raw: ⅔ cup (177 g) Thai sweet chili sauce
ingredients.name: thai sweet chili sauce

ingredients.raw: 2 teaspoons Sriracha, or more to taste
ingredients.name: sriracha

ingredients.raw: 2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts, cut into 1-inch cubes
ingredients.name: chicken breasts

ingredients.raw: 4 cups (744 g) prepared white rice, warmed, divided
ingredients.name: white rice

ingredients.raw: 2 cups (140 g) red cabbage, thinly sliced, divided
ingredients.name: red cabbage

instructions.text: Combine mayonnaise, Thai sweet chili sauce, honey, and Sriracha in a medium bowl; set aside.
Mix oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in a large bowl.
Add chicken cubes and toss to coat.
Place chicken in single layer in air fryer basket (work in batches if needed).
Air fry at 400°F for 11-12 minutes, flipping halfway, until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Add cooked chicken to a large bowl with ½ cup bang bang sauce; toss to coat.
To each of 4 bowls, add 1 cup rice, ½ cup cabbage, ¼ cup carrots, and ¼ cup cucumbers.
Top with equal portions of avocado and bang bang chicken.
Garnish each bowl with remaining sauce, cilantro, and sesame seeds; serve immediately.
